article.headline: Gold price falls as Fed hike odds jump and GLD, IAU ETF outflows surge

plan.title: Gold Price Dips Amid Fed Hike Bets
plan.hook: Gold slides as rate hike looms
plan.voiceover: Invezz reports gold slipped to $3,728 as bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike soared past 99%. Gold ETFs shed over $1.37 billion in the last month, signaling investor pullback. Watch for the December Fed decision and upcoming nonfarm payrolls—they’ll dictate gold’s next move and market risk appetite.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic b-roll of a dimly lit trading floor with digital price tickers showing fluctuating gold prices and interest rates; camera slowly pans across empty desks and glowing monitors, evoking tension and anticipation; ambient sounds include soft keyboard clicks and distant murmurs of a closed market.

Vertical 9:16 photorealistic scene of a sleek desk with a hand scrolling through financial charts on a tablet, showing gold ETF outflows and rising bond yields; soft natural morning light filters through blinds casting stripes; subtle background hum of a city waking up, reinforcing market watchfulness.

plan.post_caption: Gold faced selling pressure as Fed rate hike odds hit 99%, with ETFs seeing significant outflows. Stay tuned for key inflation data and the December Fed meeting. Source: Invezz
